title: GeneralPurposeDLHydrologicModel: Shared Graph-Recurrent Deep Learning Hydrologic Model
description: Training, evaluation, standalone baseline, and figure-generation source code and pretrained model checkpoints for GeneralPurposeDLHydrologicModel, a graph-recurrent deep learning framework (LSTM + DirectedGAT + Mixture Density Network) for daily gauged streamflow prediction, ungauged basin regionalization, and probabilistic streamflow estimation across North America.
